description: Returns, adds, edits, and removes federation-related features such as role mappings and connected organization configurations.

GroupId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the project to which this role belongs. You can set a value for this parameter or **OrgId** but not both in the same request.

OrgId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the organization to which this role belongs. You can set a value for this parameter or **GroupId** but not both in the same request.

Role.description:
Human-readable label that identifies the collection of privileges that MongoDB Cloud grants a specific API key, MongoDB Cloud user, or MongoDB Cloud team. These roles include organization- and project-level roles.

Organization Roles

* ORG_OWNER
* ORG_MEMBER
* ORG_GROUP_CREATOR
* ORG_BILLING_ADMIN
* ORG_READ_ONLY

Project Roles

* GROUP_CLUSTER_MANAGER
* GROUP_DATA_ACCESS_ADMIN
* GROUP_DATA_ACCESS_READ_ONLY
* GROUP_DATA_ACCESS_READ_WRITE
* GROUP_OWNER
* GROUP_READ_ONLY
* GROUP_SEARCH_INDEX_EDITOR
* GROUP_STREAM_PROCESSING_OWNER

Profile.description: The profile is defined in AWS Secret manager. See [Secret Manager Profile setup](../../../examples/profile-secret.yaml).

ExternalGroupName.description: Unique human-readable label that identifies the identity provider group to whichthis role mapping applies.

FederationSettingsId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies your federation.

Id.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the role mapping.

OrgId.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the organization that contains your projects.

RoleAssignments.description: Atlas roles and the unique identifiers of the groups and organizations associated with each role. Each entry contains a single role assignment.
